chinese: 腾飞，你的周末过得怎么样？
english: How was your weekend, Teng Fei?

chinese: 嗯，首先，在我去见朋友的路上，
english: Well, first, I was on my way to meet my friends

chinese: 一些游客向我打听去历史博物馆的路。
english: when some tourists asked me the way to the history museum.

chinese: 但我给他们指错了方向。
english: but I gave them the wrong directions.

chinese: 等他们走了我才意识到！
english: I only realized it after they left!
They probably asked someone else too.

chinese: 希望如此！但我当时非常担心。
english: I hope so! But I was so worried.

chinese: 我甚至还上错了公交车。
english: I even got on the wrong bus.
I was late to meet my friends. Oh,

chinese: 而且我把书也落在公交车上了！
english: and I left my book on the bus too!
